name: Pending banner help
description: Help mode entries (help@1) for the Pending banner.
author: Brett

entries.title: Send all to Queue
entries.text: Moves every build waiting in Pending to the Queue in one tap. The dispatcher starts each one when a slot and an account for its model are free.

entries.title: Queue the ticked builds
entries.text: Moves just the builds you ticked to the Queue.

entries.title: Hold the ticked builds
entries.text: Moves the ticked builds into the Queue on hold: they keep their place, and nothing starts until you release them in the orchestrator.

entries.title: Archive the ticked builds
entries.text: Moves the ticked builds to the Archive. You can bring them back from the orchestrator's Archive tab.

entries.title: Pending banner settings
entries.text: What the Pending banner shows now, a check-now button and how to reach the same moves from the API, MCP, the CLI and voice.

entries.title: Pending builds
entries.text: Every build waiting in Pending: what it does, its priority, steps done and why it is there (new, or fell back from a run). Queue, Hold, Archive or Open each one, tick several for a bulk move, or send them all to the Queue.
